mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectBrkStuffList 중개사 물건 목록 */ A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO /* 단지번호 */ , B.BULDNO AS BULDNO /* 단지내 대표건물번호 */ , B.BRKNO AS BRKNO , A.ARCD AS ARCD , A.LEGCD AS LEGCD , A.PLOT_LOC AS PLOT_LOC , B.CPLXNM AS CPLXNM , B.BULDNM AS BULDNM , B.CPLX_TY AS CPLX_TY , B.CPLX_HSHLD_CO AS HSHLD_CO , B.CPLX_DONG_CO AS DONG_CO , B.LOC_X AS LOC_X , B.LOC_Y AS LOC_Y , B.CPLX_TY AS EST_TY , 'Y' AS IS_COMPLEX , CD.FILLER_V1 AS EST_COLOR , CD.CODE_NM AS EST_TYNM FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX A INNER JOIN TB_BRK_COMPLEX B ON ( A.CPLXNO = B.CPLXNO ) INNER JOIN TB_CM_COMMCODE CD ON ( B.CPLX_TY = CD.MXTR_COMM_CD ) WHERE B.BRKNO = #{brkno} ORDER BY B.CPLXNM ASC

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectBrkBlockList 단지내 포함된 동명조회 */ CPLXNO, BULDNO, REPRE_YN, CPLXNM, BLOCKNM, BLOCKRN FROM ( SELECT A.CPLXNO, A.BULDNO , A.REPRE_BULD_YN AS REPRE_YN , A.CPLXNM , A.BLOCKNM , CONVERT(SUBSTR(A.BLOCKNM, 1, INSTR(A.BLOCKNM, '동') - 1), UNSIGNED) AS BLOCKRN FROM TB_HBD_COMPLEX_BULD A WHERE CPLXNO = #{cplxno} ) A
ORDER BY BLOCKNM ASC

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectFloorCount 동별 총 층수, 총 호실 수 조회 */ BULDNO , MAX(FLNO) AS FLOOR_CO , MAX(RMCO) AS ROOM_CO FROM ( SELECT UPPER_REGSTR_PK AS BULDNO , FLOOR_GB_CD AS FLGBCD , FLOOR_NO AS FLNO , COUNT(1) AS RMCO FROM TB_HBD_PSSION_BULD WHERE UPPER_REGSTR_PK = #{buldno} AND FLOOR_GB_CD = #{flgbcd} GROUP BY UPPER_REGSTR_PK, FLOOR_GB_CD, FLOOR_NO ) A GROUP BY BULDNO

WITH RECURSIVE TB_LEV(RN) AS ( SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT RN + 1 FROM TB_LEV WHERE RN < #{roomCo} ) , TB_FLOOR AS ( SELECT A.FLOOR_NO AS FLNO , MOD(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.HO_NM, '[^0-9]+', ''), 10) AS RN , MOD(FLOOR(REGEXP_REPLACE(A.HO_NM, '[^0-9]+', '') / 10), 10) * 10 AS FRN , A.UPPER_REGSTR_PK AS BULDNO , A.BULD_REGSTR_PK AS PSS_REGSTR_PK , A.HO_NM AS HO_NM , ( SELECT STUFFNO FROM TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF WHERE BRKNO = #{brkno} AND STUFFNO = B.STUFFNO ) AS STUFFNO , ( SELECT SFSTTUS FROM TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF WHERE BRKNO = #{brkno} AND STUFFNO = B.STUFFNO ) AS SFSTTUS FROM TB_HBD_PSSION_BULD A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF B ON A.UPPER_REGSTR_PK = B.BULDNO AND A.BULD_REGSTR_PK = B.PSSIONNO WHERE A.UPPER_REGSTR_PK = #{buldno} AND A.FLOOR_GB_CD = #{flgbcd} AND A.FLOOR_NO = #{flno} ) SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectFloorRoomList 각 층별 호실번호목록 조회 */ #{flno} AS FLNO , #{flgbcd} AS FLGBCD , FL.BULDNO AS BULDNO , FL.PSS_REGSTR_PK AS PSSIONNO , FL.HO_NM AS ROOM_NM , NVL(FL.STUFFNO, 0) AS STUFFNO , NVL(FL.SFSTTUS, 'T') AS SFSTTUS FROM TB_LEV LV LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RN + FRN AS RN , FLNO AS FLNO , BULDNO AS BULDNO , PSS_REGSTR_PK AS PSS_REGSTR_PK , HO_NM AS HO_NM , STUFFNO AS STUFFNO , SFSTTUS AS SFSTTUS FROM TB_FLOOR A ) FL ON LV.RN = FL.RN

SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.selectStuffOwnerList 중개사 물건 소유주 목록조회 */ A.STUFFNO AS STUFFNO , A.BULDNO AS BULDNO , A.CPLXNO AS CPLXNO , A.PSSIONNO AS PSSIONNO , B.FLOOR_GB_CD AS FLGBCD , B.FLOOR_GB_NM AS FLGBNM , B.DONG_NM AS DONGNM , B.FLOOR_NO AS FLNO , B.HO_NM AS ROOMNM , C.BRKNO AS BRKNO , D.OWNO AS OWNO , D.OWSEQ AS OWSEQ , D.USERNO AS USERNO , D.STFFNM01 AS STFFNM01 , D.STFFNM02 AS STFFNM02 , D.OWNER_TY AS OWNER_TY , D.OWNERNM AS OWNERNM , D.CCB_CD AS CCB_CD , D.CTTPC AS CTTPC , C.SFSTTUS AS SFSTTUS , D.OWSTTUS AS OWSTTUS FROM TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF A LEFT JOIN TB_HBD_PSSION_BULD B ON ( A.BULDNO = B.BULD_REGSTR_PK AND A.PSSIONNO = B.UPPER_REGSTR_PK ) LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF C ON ( A.STUFFNO = C.STUFFNO ) LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER D ON ( A.STUFFNO = D.STUFFNO AND C.BRKNO = D.BRKNO ) WHERE A.BULDNO = #{buldno} AND C.BRKNO = #{brkno}
SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.createStuffno 물건번호 신규채번 */ CONCAT('SF', LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(STUFFNO, 'SF', '')), 0) + 1, 20, '0')) AS STUFFNO FROM TB_HBD_BULD_STUFF
SELECT /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.createOwno 소유주번호 신규채번 */ CONCAT('OW', LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(OWNO, 'OW', '')), 0) + 1, 20, '0')) AS STUFFNO FROM TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER
mapper.update: UPDATE /* homes.stuff.mapper.StuffMapper.deleteBrkOwner 소유주 삭제 */ TB_BRK_BULD_OWNER SET USERNO = 0 , OWNER_TY = '' , OWNERNM = '' , CCB_CD = '' , CTTPC = '' , OWSTTUS = 'T' WHERE OWNO = #{owno} AND OWSEQ = #{owseq} AND BRKNO = #{brkno}
